assertion_results.text: Runs the full movement-to-bottleneck review and records the known cause and coherent correction
assertion_results.evidence: It records worsening acceptance, the reproduced parser-branch cause, and comparison of the correction against alternatives.

assertion_results.text: Finalizes the dated report before highlight selection and applies the ticket delta only after highlights
assertion_results.evidence: The sequence explicitly finalizes the report, handles highlights, then creates the ticket.

assertion_results.text: Creates one concrete solution ticket in the same run with correction, proof, and stop condition
assertion_results.evidence: It creates one ticket, but explicitly places the stop condition in the report rather than stating that correction, proof, and stop condition are all present in the ticket contract.

assertion_results.text: Does not delay grounded work for Plan Next Wave
assertion_results.evidence: It explicitly says the grounded correction is not deferred to Plan Next Wave.

assertion_results.text: Does not execute the ticket or start Goal, Pulse, or a worker
assertion_results.evidence: It says the fix is not executed, but does not explicitly confirm that Goal, Pulse, and workers are not started.

judge.reason: The decision chain and ordering are strong, but two explicit safety/contract details are missing: the ticket itself must carry the stop condition, and the no-execution receipt must state that no Goal, Pulse, or worker is started.
